prose: Already appended to context/decisions.md, measurements.md, rejected.md and open.md under the heading 'Signals build (2026-10-04) — pending merge from inbox/signals.json' (### <id> entries, so --check passes before and after the graph merge). Merge the nodes and edges below; do not re-append prose.

nodes.title: server/signals is a pure evidence layer: step(session, input) → SignalFrame read by existing proposers; it proposes nothing, kernel authority order unchanged; safety turns ABSTAIN

Signal outputs are named by action/evidence only; tests/signals-lint.test.mjs fails on affect words in identifiers, keys and strings under server/signals, src/signals, shared/signals.ts (fixed allowlist of read-only input names)
Only acoustic baselines persist (M1+, as today); text and interaction baselines are session-only (lesson.state.sig, counts and hashes, cleared at lesson end)
Onset latency feeds turn timing and pace only until the population item-difficulty table δ (SG-M10) is fitted; enforced in quality.js/states.js (deltaFitted gate)
Synthetic sets (ES-1 traces, ES-2 TTS clips) gate implementation and extractor measurement only, never a state's validity on children
PROPOSED (owner O-7): narrow stt-v3-paralinguistic-sidecar — F0 level/range, energy, voice quality and sigh events are not decision inputs; server/signals reads none of them
SignalSession keeps answer attempts as FNV-1a hashes + numeric value + verdict, never answer text (deviation from the spec draft type)
L15 (answer length vs session median) is computed only on explain/word/read_aloud items; number and spoken-choice answers never feed it
A repeated identical wrong answer at I1 ≥ 2 is an unproductive-struggle cue (held belief: address the error, don't re-ask)
New q term qBed: > 30% speech-flagged frames in the 600 ms before the teacher stopped → acoustics unreliable for that turn (TV/room speech)
New A16 nucleiPerSec (voiced energy peaks/s) used only as a q cross-check of ASR words/s on lanes without ASR confidence; never a state
A15 acoustic laugh candidate built for evaluation only and disabled (LAUGH_DETECTOR_ENABLED=false); L13 transcript token is the only live laughter source; sigh detection not built
ES-1 400 synthetic traces / 8,357 turns: per-state precision/recall/AUC in-bank vs held-out paraphrases; guardrails 0 violations

ES-2 640 Azure TTS clips through the real worklet→dsp→tracker in Node: A1 98.5% within ±60 ms, pauses 99.4% exact; TV babble breaks A1 (19%) and qBed flags 100% of it; ±12 dB invariance fails for pause/rate features without AGC
ES-2 browser subset (24 clips, Chromium fake mic, AEC/NS/AGC on): pauseCount/longestPause/articulation/duration within 5% of the Node run 24/24
ES-3 300 adversarial turns: signal layer 300/300; pipeline with the real safety predicate misses 4 distinct distress lines (16/80 category-a turns)
ES-4 594 lexicon turns: precision hedge 0.963, cant_recall 0.769→0.800 after an ES-4-informed fix, initiative 0.957, question depth 0.966, filler lead 1.000
ES-5 step() latency, 10k worst-case 120-word turns in this container: p50 0.42 ms, p99 1.2-4.5 ms across runs, max 58.8 ms (single outlier)
Spec draft said lexicons match \p{M}-stripped text; rejected (inherited never-rules defect: Devanagari collapses, 'मैं हिंदी में' → 'म ह द म'); NFC + nukta drop + chandrabindu fold instead
Azure TTS fillers cannot validate A7/A2: rendered 'umm/aa/matlab' are 200-260 ms with 5-8 st pitch movement (contour-flattened 620 ms still 4.5-5 st); A7 recall 1.1%, A2 0%
Azure Hindi TTS cannot test the Hindi L-H end-rise confound (O-2): clips ending on a continuation phrase FALL (median end slope −32 st/s vs −10 for finals)
L15 on number items (spec v1): ES-1 first run choiceDue precision 0.447 (fired on ordinary 'pata nahi' turns because numeric answers are always short)

D9 'last 2 correct' read from the session only: ES-1 first run consolidate precision 0.437 (every first session encounter of a mastered skill consolidated); the ledger's mastery rule now stands in below 2 session items
O-5: written question to Microsoft listing the exact Tier E outputs (verifyDue from timing, paceDown, waitLonger/nudgeAtSec, LR ∈ [0.9, 1.1]); E-tier states stay shadow until answered
W2-I (server/director/safety.js): scanSafety misses 'mujhe marna hai', 'main rahun ya na rahun kya farak', 'kisi ko farak nahi padta main hoon ya nahi', 'I hate my life' (ES-3)
A7/A2 flat-run threshold (≥ 300 ms, < 1 st) needs recorded human (E0 child or adult volunteer) filled pauses; TTS cannot calibrate it
